seo.title: Barborská cesta — Digital Trail Guide
seo.description: 193 km pilgrimage and hiking trail in central Slovakia. 29 stops, 9 stages. Digital passport, map, services.

gdpr.title: Your Privacy
gdpr.collectDesc: Stops visited, location at check-in, country, age, travel mode.
gdpr.whyDesc: To help municipalities improve trail services.
gdpr.notDoDesc: We don't sell, share, or track you outside the app.
gdpr.note: If you decline, the app works the same — we just won't save statistics.
gdpr.change: You can change this in privacy settings.

gps.enableDesc: We use your location to find the nearest stop and verify check-ins.

gps.deniedDesc: Your browser doesn't have permission to access location. Please enable location in your device settings.

stopDesc.1: Starting point of the pilgrimage at the Church of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary. The Barbakan castle complex houses the Thurzo-Fugger experience exhibition about the history of the largest copper processing company in medieval Europe.
stopDesc.2: A district of Banská Bystrica with the Church of St. James. From here begins the ascent on the longest Way of the Cross in the former Upper Hungary, leading to Špania Dolina.
stopDesc.3: Heritage reservation of folk architecture with the Copper Museum. Copper mines have been operating here since the 10th century. The Herrengrund Mining Brotherhood is active here.
stopDesc.4: An abandoned mining settlement in the mountains between Špania Dolina and Staré Hory. A place with a rich mining history.
stopDesc.5: A well-known Marian pilgrimage site with the Basilica Minor and the Studnička spring, which according to legend has healing properties.
stopDesc.6: A village where paper has been produced for nearly 200 years. The Harmanec paper mill is today one of the largest producers in Central Europe.
stopDesc.7: A mountain guesthouse on the route between Harmanec and Kordíky. A pleasant place for refreshment with views of Veľká Fatra.
stopDesc.8: A former charcoal-making village in the heart of the Kremnica Mountains. Well-preserved traditional mountain architecture.
stopDesc.9: A historic tunnel that played a key role during the Slovak National Uprising — gold reserves from Kremnica were transported through it to the National Bank in Banská Bystrica. Part of the Golden Road.
stopDesc.10: A recreation center below the ridge of the Kremnica Mountains. The Skalka mountain hut offers accommodation and views of Veľká Fatra.
stopDesc.11: A village once settled by German residents. Nearby stands the Church of St. John the Baptist at the geographical center of Europe.
stopDesc.12: A village with the Šturec sinkhole — site of a great mining tragedy from the 15th century. Visible traces of intensive gold mining remain.
stopDesc.13: The world's oldest continuously operating mint (since 1328). Coin Museum, Mining Museum, town castle. Try the local Kremnica potatoes.
stopDesc.14: A village near Kremnica with bentonite quarries. A gateway into the valley heading south.
stopDesc.15: Ruins of Šášov Castle, which served as a guard castle protecting important trade routes in the Middle Ages.
stopDesc.16: A spa town with thermal springs. Unique cave bath Parenica. In the 18th century, the world's first scientific society was established here.
stopDesc.17: A former charcoal-making village. Nearby stands Marcus Castle — a modern replica of a medieval castle.
stopDesc.18: A UNESCO World Heritage city. Old and New Castles, Calvary, Mining Academy, water reservoirs. Multimedia exhibition Journey Through Time and Mining Open-Air Museum.
stopDesc.19: A Baroque complex from the 18th century with 17 chapels and 3 churches — one of the most significant landmarks of the region.
stopDesc.20: An 18th-century hunting manor, former seat of the Koháry and Coburg families. Today a museum with a rich hunting exhibition.
stopDesc.21: A village with a swimming reservoir and excellent homemade langosh. A pleasant rest stop in the middle of the trail.
stopDesc.22: A small village in the hills of the Štiavnica Mountains with views of the Hron valley.
stopDesc.23: A village with a newly opened community Alberg for pilgrims. Ostrolúcky Manor — memorial room of Adela Ostrolúcka.
stopDesc.24: Zvolen Castle — a Gothic royal castle from 1370. One of the largest town squares in Slovakia. Statue of the Merchant of Venice.
stopDesc.25: One of the largest castle complexes in Europe above Zvolen. Via ferrata Sokolie skaly. Koliba U Rytiera restaurant.
stopDesc.26: A spa town with healing thermal springs (cardiology). Mineral water from the Štefánik spring.
stopDesc.27: Monastery of the Transfiguration of the Lord, maintained by Benedictines. A peaceful place for spiritual contemplation.
stopDesc.28: A UNESCO wooden articular church from 1726 — a unique structure built without nails. A 14th-century water castle.
stopDesc.29: An observatory on the site of a former watchtower that protected the region from the Ottomans. Banská Bystrica Calvary and Urpín hill. End of the pilgrimage — 193 km!

serviceDesc.1: Family guesthouse with breakfast for pilgrims in the historic center. Quiet garden and shoe dryer.
serviceDesc.2: Traditional Slovak cuisine with local ingredients. Lunch menu for pilgrims.
serviceDesc.3: Bicycle and e-bike repairs, battery charging, rentals.
serviceDesc.4: Tourist information center. Pilgrim passport sales, stamps, trail information.
serviceDesc.5: Refreshments at the Copper Museum. Local products and beverages.
serviceDesc.6: Community pilgrim hostel. Mattress, blanket, bring your own sleeping bag. Kitchen and common room.
serviceDesc.7: Guesthouse with breakfast near the basilica. Comfortable rooms, restaurant.
serviceDesc.8: Spring with reportedly healing water near the basilica. Traditional pilgrimage site.
serviceDesc.9: Mountain guesthouse with restaurant. Dumplings, pierogi, homemade pastries. Accommodation for pilgrims.
serviceDesc.10: Mountain hut with accommodation and restaurant. Views of Veľká Fatra. Drying room and bike service.
serviceDesc.11: Simple accommodation in the village of Krahule. Kitchen, common room.
serviceDesc.12: Europe Spring near the geographical center of Europe. A symbolic place with an information board.
serviceDesc.13: Hotel in the center of Kremnica. Restaurant with traditional cuisine, Kremnica potatoes.
serviceDesc.14: Drinking water from a natural spring right by the road in the town center.
serviceDesc.15: Café in the mint complex. Coffee, pastries, souvenirs. Stamp for pilgrims.
serviceDesc.16: Thermal spa with the Parenica cave bath. Relaxation for tired pilgrims.
serviceDesc.17: Guesthouse with restaurant and wellness in the spa town.
serviceDesc.18: Historic hotel in the center of the UNESCO city. Restaurant, wellness, view of Calvary.
serviceDesc.19: Craft beers and traditional dishes on Trinity Square. Local ingredients.
serviceDesc.20: Mining open-air museum in nature. Drinking water, WC, stamp. Entrance to the Bartolomej tunnel.
serviceDesc.21: Refreshments in the manor complex. Hunting exhibition, park, stamp.
serviceDesc.22: Newly opened community Alberg for pilgrims. Shared dormitory, kitchen, drying room.
serviceDesc.23: Restaurant below Pustý Hrad castle. Grilled specialties, local beers, castle view.
serviceDesc.24: Hotel in the center of Zvolen near the square. Restaurant, parking.
serviceDesc.25: Healing thermal spa, cardiology treatment. Štefánik mineral spring.
serviceDesc.26: Historic water castle from the 14th century. Accommodation in a renovated manor.
serviceDesc.27: Bicycle repair, spare parts, e-bike charging.
serviceDesc.28: Shelter with benches near the historic tunnel. Information board about the Golden Road.
serviceDesc.29: Shelter at the castle with a fire pit. Panoramic view of Zvolen and Poľana.
